## [1.3.0](https://github.com/amit-0i/myspoti-morphe-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-11-01)

### ✨ New Features

* **playback:** prioritize local playback for downloaded songs ([2ec3219](https://github.com/amit-0i/myspoti-morphe-patches/commit/2ec32199a0ab9b6063299cf861d43936eb30fc28))

patches.name: Spotify branding
patches.description: Renames MySpoti to Spotify and replaces every launcher, themed, supporter-preview, splash, widget, and notification mark with Spotify branding.

patches.name: MySpoti Export & Storage
patches.description: Adds Export & storage to Settings > Downloads in MySpoti 2.3.0, local-first playback for downloaded tracks, tagged audio exports, offline lyrics resolution/cache, portable LRC and JSON lyrics, embedded lyrics, playlist/album M3U8 manifests, reinstall restoration into native Downloads and lyrics caches, shared track files and offline storage migration.
